tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GXP1628 Gigabit HD IP Phone is a reliable and cost-effective VoIP communication solution designed for small and medium-sized businesses. Featuring 2 SIP accounts, dual Gigabit Ethernet ports, integrated PoE, HD audio, and 8 BLF/speed-dial keys, the GXP1628 delivers excellent call quality and productivity for office users. Its intuitive interface and backlit LCD display make call management simple and efficient.


Built with enterprise-grade security and advanced provisioning capabilities, the GXP1628 supports secure voice communications through TLS and SRTP encryption. The phone also offers 3-way conferencing, EHS headset support, and centralized deployment options, making it an ideal choice for businesses looking for a dependable IP telephony solution.


Key Features

  • Supports 2 SIP Accounts and 2 Line Keys
  • Dual Gigabit Ethernet Ports (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • Integrated IEEE 802.3af Power over Ethernet (PoE)
  • HD Audio on Handset and Speakerphone
  • 8 Dual-Color BLF / Speed Dial Keys
  • 3-Way Audio Conferencing
  • 132 × 48 Backlit Graphical LCD Display
  • 3 XML Programmable Soft Keys
  • EHS Support for Compatible Headsets
  • TLS & SRTP Security Encryption
  • Automated Provisioning via TR-069 and XML Files
  • Up to 1000 Phonebook Contacts and 200 Call Records
